d:
Lokaaastha ka mahaparv chhath bihar ki pahchan hai..ye vo paranpra hai jo sadiyon se chali aa rahi hai. maujuda samay men vakt badal raha hai, jivan jine ke taur-tarikon men bhi bara badlav aaya hai,pirhiyan badal rahi hain. samaj men sanyukt parivaron ki jagah ekal parivaron ki sankhya barh rahi hai aur in sabhi badlavon men jo atal, achal aur shashvat hai vo hai chhath mahaparv.
